verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents its own CLI, which runs local models from the terminal offline and without an account, so a non-GUI runtime path exists. Nothing documents server or CI use, and the hosted path needs browser sign-in, which makes unattended pipelines harder. Missing for 10: explicit headless/server deployment docs, documented CI usage or non-interactive authentication, Linux/server platform support evidence, and hands-on corroboration of headless operation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime headlessly with no GUI for use in servers or CI pipelines

citations.quote: When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
